Evidence: Fleet Sensor 4 increased by 22.3255 native units and Sensor 11 by 0.6811 between early and late observations.
Proposed_Action: Develop trend monitoring for selected temperature and pressure channels. Evaluate baseline-relative changes, sensor quality, and operating context.
Expected_Benefit: Improved visibility into developing equipment-condition changes.
Validation_Requirement: Confirm sensor definitions, calibration, normal operating ranges, and behavior using representative equipment data.

Evidence: Near-failure predictions overestimated remaining life 75.16% of the time on held-out validation engines.
Proposed_Action: Investigate calibrated prediction intervals, conservative lower-bound estimates, and explicit uncertainty reporting rather than relying on point predictions alone.
Expected_Benefit: Better understanding of prediction uncertainty and optimistic model errors.
Validation_Requirement: Evaluate calibration, coverage, false alarms, missed detections, and maintenance consequences on independent datasets.

Evidence: The simulated fleet ranged from 128 to 362 operating cycles, with a standard deviation of 46.34 cycles.
Proposed_Action: Compare engine-level histories and investigate variation in sensor behavior, operating conditions, and failure timing.
Expected_Benefit: Identification of unusual histories for further engineering investigation.
Validation_Requirement: Account for operating regimes, exposure, maintenance history, and differences between engine populations.

Evidence: Model errors differ across remaining-life stages and individual validation engines.
Proposed_Action: Design a prototype review queue combining sensor anomalies, data quality flags, model uncertainty, and engineer assessment. Do not use unvalidated RUL predictions as automatic inspection triggers.
Expected_Benefit: A structured approach to reviewing potential equipment concerns.
Validation_Requirement: Have qualified maintenance engineers evaluate proposed rules against approved procedures and actual failure outcomes.

Evidence: Held-out validation MAE was 25.71 cycles and RMSE was 35.20 cycles.
Proposed_Action: Compare additional models, assess feature stability, test prediction calibration, and evaluate generalization across operating conditions.
Expected_Benefit: More reliable characterization of model accuracy and limitations.
Validation_Requirement: Use engine-level separation, untouched test data, and documented evaluation criteria. Avoid test-data leakage.
